title: Comprehensive Protocols to Isolate, Characterize, and Culture pure-population of Multi-potent Stem Cell from Mouse Epidermis
protocol: Wear sterile gloves while handling neonate Balb/c mice.
Asphyxiate 10 pups aged 0-3 days old by CO2-Narcosis.
Place carcass on a sterile tray and wipe-clean gently using sterile cotton-pads soaked in 70% ethanol.
Wipe gently again using sterile cotton pads soaked in Betadine-solution; keep carcass packed in iodine-soaked cotton-pads for 10 minutes.
Rinse carcass with MiliQ autoclaved water and subsequently with 70% ethanol in a sterile container.
Shift carcass aseptically to Laminar Flow Hood and change gloves for processing in Laminar Flow.
Excise trunk skin in one piece using sterile dissection tools such as surgical scissors, fine or toothed forceps, and surgical blade mounted on a scalpel.
Cut limbs just above wrist- and ankle-joints leaving visible stumps.
Hold tail and lacerate skin by an incision near the lower-sacrum.
Insert scissor through cut-open skin and cut tissue smoothly along the dorsal midline of the carcass up to the nose-tip.
Loosen skin gently from the midline using a fine forceps and a toothed forceps to expose subcutaneous muscular integument.
Grip the carcass with a toothed forceps and peel off skin gently beginning from the hind-leg stumps.
Hold the dorsal skin flap and continue peeling off gently to the ventral side using forceps until whole skin is excised.
Collect skin specimens immediately in DPBS-1%Pen-strep (100X)-0.25mg/ml amphotericin B.
Wash tissue specimens with PBS-Antibiotics solution.
Rinse specimens immediately with PBS-2%Antibiotic mixture for 2 minutes.
Wash with sterile milliQ water for 2 minutes followed by rinsing with 70% ethanol for 1 minute.
Collect specimens again in fresh PBS-1%Antibiotic mixture for 1 minute.
Keep specimens in PBS-1%Antibiotic solution until removal of subcutaneous fat.
Remove fat by placing specimens dermis side-up on a sterile culture dish.
Use sterile surgical tools to get rid of subcutaneous fat gently and carefully.
Skin tissue should look almost transparent after removing fat when examined against a light source.
Place specimens epidermis-side up in 5 ml Dispase solution in a sterile 60 mm Petri dish.
Spread tissue carefully, allowing specimens to float serenely on Dispase.
Incubate specimens at 4°C overnight.
Arrange autoclaved materials under sterile conditions in a Laminar Flow Hood.
Remove overnight-Dispase-digested specimens and place them epidermis-side-up on a sterile 60mm petri dish.
Peel off the epidermis gently using sterile forceps.
Transfer the epidermis specimen into a sterile 50ml centrifuge tube containing 5ml of 0.25% trypsin-1mM EDTA.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 25°C in the Laminar hood.
Agitate the tissue slowly 1-10 times to dissociate cells.
Add 20 ml of SMEM+20%FBS medium and agitate again to further dissociate cells.
Filter the cell suspension patiently through an autoclaved nylon cloth filter (mesh size 100micron) using a sterile 20ml syringe in 100µl aliquots.
Replace the nylon cloth filter with another of 80micron mesh and repeat the filtering process patiently.
Collect filtrate in a sterile 15ml conical centrifuge tube.
Spin to pellet cells at 500g for 10min at 4°C in swing-out bucket type rotor.
Discard supernatant and re-suspend the cell-pellet in 5ml fresh medium.
Spin at 300g for 10min at 4°C.
Aspirate supernatant and re-suspend pellet in 2ml GPM.
Determine cell density and seed 1×10^6 primary cells in 5ml GPM in 25cm² flasks coated with fibronectin and collagen type-IV.
Allow cells to attach in 10min.
Decant media carefully over the side of the flask.
Add GPM 5ml/flask slowly over the side of the flask.
Place flasks in CO₂ incubator at 37°C and 5%CO₂.
Replace media first after 4d of seeding with fresh medium thereafter every alternate day.
Trypsinize cells for 1-2 minutes when they achieve 80-90% confluence in primary culture using trypsin-EDTA.
Inactivate trypsin with SMEM-20% FBS-chelexed.
Seed 5×10^5 cells in 5 ml GPM for sub-culture in T25 flask.
Suspend 5 × 10^5 cells in 1 ml freezing medium (FBS-chelexed + 10% DMSO-sterile).
Freeze serially through a sequential temperature-decreasing program (4°C for 3-4 hours, -20°C and -80°C overnight, then in liquid nitrogen finally).
Fix cells with 4% PFA/PBS for 10 minutes.
Wash cells with PBS.
Fix cells with methanol for 10 minutes.
Wash cells three times with PBS-0.1% Tween20.
Block samples in 1% BSA/0.1% Tween 20/PBS (2 hours).
Incubate samples with Hoechst dye for 10 minutes.
Wash cells with PBS.
Mount cells with Vectashield mounting medium.
Spot and document mycoplasma in cells using fluorescence microscopy as per instructions from kit manufacturer.
Sacrifice animals by cervical dislocation.
Wash carcass using 70% ethanol and Betadine solution.
Excise the hairless area from the inter-scapular region using sterile dissection tools.
Place skin specimens immediately in D-PBS-1% Pen-strep-0.25mg/ml amphotericin-B.
Shift to laminar hood and wash as previously described.
Put the specimen epidermis-side down on a 60mm culture plate.
Scrap subcutaneous fat using surgical blade and toothed forceps.
Add 4ml Dispase solution and incubate at 4°C overnight or for 10 hours.
Remove Dispase and add 0.25% trypsin-1mM EDTA; keep at 37°C for 60 minutes.
Peel off epidermis from dermis gently using fine and toothed forceps.
Collect epidermis specimens in flask containing 20ml GPM.
Stir 30 minutes using magnetic stirrer to dissociate cells into suspension.
Filter cell-suspension using nylon mesh with 100 micrometer.
Follow by filtering through a nylon mesh with 80 micrometers.
Collect cells in a 15ml centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 500xg for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Add fresh GPM and centrifuge at 300xg for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet.
Cut the tail base to excise up to 2 cm from the tip.
Cut the tail specimen into three pieces.
Remove sub-cutaneous fat from the tail specimen.
Place excised skin into PBS-antibiotic solution.
Wash sample as described previously (STEP # 1.2.9 -1.2.12).
Place dermal side down in dispase solution for digestion.
Cut ear-pinnae from the head-joint of mice.
Peel ear skin gently along the ventral area towards the dorsal side to avoid fragmentation.
Avoid hairy parts at joints during dissection.
Place peeled ear skin along the cartilage into PBS-antibiotic mixture.
Wash tissue specimen as described previously.
Remove cartilage and subcutaneous fat using scalpel & blade.
Place ear skin dermis side down in dispase solution allowing digestion as previously.
Fix cells with 4% PFA/PBS for 10 minutes.
Wash with PBS and fix with methanol for 10 minutes.
Wash three times with PBS-0.1% Tween-20 (PBST).
Block samples in 1% BSA/0.1% Tween 20/PBS for 2 hours.
Incubate with primary antibodies overnight at 4°C as per the kit-instructions.
Wash with PBS and incubate sections with rabbit anti-mouse-Alexa flore-conjugated (1/200) secondary antibody for 2 hours at room temperature.
Rinse with PBST and mount with Vectashield solution containing DAPI.
Spot and document cells using fluorescence microscope.
Lysate cells with ice-cold Celllytic-M containing 10mM NaF, 1mM Na₃VO₄, and 1mM PMSF.
Centrifuge cell lysates at 15,000rpm for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Determine protein content using the Bradford method with BSA as a standard.
Separate proteins (40mg) by 10% SDS-PAGE and transfer to nitrocellulose paper.
Block membranes with 5% fat-free dry milk or 5% BSA in TBS-T for 1 hour at room temperature.
Incubate membranes overnight at 4°C with primary monoclonal antibodies (keratin-10, -14, -15, -19, beta-1-integrin, p63, CD34) diluted 1:1,000–1:5,000 in TBS-T containing 1% skim milk or BSA.
Wash membranes three times with TBS-T at room temperature for 10 minutes each time.

Incubate membranes with secondary peroxidase-conjugated anti-mouse and anti-rabbit antibodies diluted 1:1,000 in TBS-T containing 1% fat-free dry milk for 1-2 hours at room temperature or overnight at 4°C.
Detect proteins using an enhanced chemiluminescence kit (ECLPlus Western blotting kit).
Quantify Western blots by densitometry using VersaDoc and Quantity-One software.
Fix cultured cells on chamber slides in fixation buffer for 15 minutes.
Wash slides twice with PBS, each time for 5 minutes.
Incubate slides with diluents buffer for 30 minutes to permeabilize cells.
Wash slides twice.
Incubate slides for 10 minutes in 0.3% H2O2 in PBS to block endogenous peroxidase activity.
Rinse slides thrice, 5 minutes each in PBS.
Retrieve antigen using BD Retrievagen-A by mixing 9 ml solution-1 and 41 ml solution-2 with distilled water up to 500 ml as described in the kit.
Place the slide in a coplin jar containing the working solution of BD-Retrievgen-A.
Place the entire setup in hot water at 89°C for 10 minutes.
Remove the coplin jar with slides and cover it tightly, allowing the solution to cool down slowly to room temperature over 20 minutes.
Rinse slides thrice, 2 minutes each in PBS.
Incubate with ready-to-use-streptavidin-HRP for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse slides thrice, 2 minutes each in PBS.
Incubate slides for 5 minutes with DAB substrate solution and cover the slide.
Prepare DAB solution by adding 1 drop of DAB chromogen to 1 ml DAB buffer provided in kit.
Rinse slides thrice, 2 minutes each in double distilled water.
Dehydrate slides 5 minutes each serially through 2 changes of 95%, 100% alcohol.
Clear slides in three changes of xyline and coverslip the specimen.
Wash cells (0.5 × 10^6 cells/ml SMEM-medium) twice with cold PBS.
Resuspend the cell pellet in residual supernatant.
Place cells on ice for 30 minutes and then resuspend in residual supernatant.
Add a copious amount of 4N HCl (15 ml).
Allow the cell-pellet to stand at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Pellet cells again and resuspend in PBS (10^6 cells/ml).
Aliquot 1 ml of cell suspension into a polystyrene tube and pellet the cells.
Wash once with 0.5% Tween-20.
Mix the pellet with 10 μl of FITC-conjugated anti-BrdU antibody.
Vortex the contents.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Wash cells twice with PBS.
Resuspend finally in 1 ml of PBS before analysis on a BD-FACS-Calibur flow cytometer.
Sort cells using BD-CellQuest-Pro software.
Set gates using forward light scatter (FSC) and side light scatter (SSC).
Detect anti-BrdU monoclonal antibody FITC-conjugated fluorescence on FL1-H channel (Excitation 488 nm, Emission 530 nm ± 30 nm band pass).
Acquire a total of 10,000 events for each sample.
Plot FL1-H data on log scale.
Use stem cell culture from the 3rd passage after collagen-fibronectin-adherence selection.
Trypsinize cells and pellet at 300Xg for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells twice in 1% BSA to prevent loss due to stickiness onto the FACSAria tube lumen.
Resuspend cells at a concentration of 1×10^6 cells/ml in Growth Promoting Medium with 1mM HEPES and 5μg/ml Hoechst-33342.
Incubate cells in the Hoechst dye-medium mixture at 37°C for 90 minutes.
Pellet cells and resuspend in Growth Promoting medium containing 1ug/ml Propidium iodide.
Proceed to analyze using FACSAria in rectilinear sort gate.
Sacrifice neonatal mouse and excise skin.
Place tissue in 70% ethanol for 1 minute.
Wash extensively with Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺-free-PBS.
Incubate specimens in dispase overnight at 4°C.
Peel epidermis from dermis the next day.
Obtain single cell suspension by gently shaking the epidermis.
Pellet cells at 300Xg for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells twice in 1%BSA to avoid loss due to stickiness onto the FACSAria tube surface.
Resuspend 5 × 10^6 cells/ml in Growth-Promoting-Medium containing 1mM HEPES and 5 μg/ml Hoechst33342.
Incubate the cell-Hoechst dye-medium mixture for 90 minutes at 37°C.
Pellet the cells and resuspend them in growth-promoting medium containing 1 μg/ml Propidium iodide.
Place the resuspended cells on ice until sorting.
Sort cells using a FACSDiva cell sorter (Becton Dickinson).
Acquire 50,000 events for each sample in list mode.
Gate out debris and cells positive for propidium iodide.
Set pressure to 20 PSI and pressure difference to 0.8.
Perform cell sorting on the FACSAria-DiVa (Becton Dickinson).
Configure equipment with non-rectilinear sort-gates as shown.

Set parameters for Propidium Iodide at 370mW, DAPI at 190mW, Hoechst at 355nm excitation and 450/50nm emission band pass filter, and Propidium Iodide at 488nm excitation and 575/25nm emission band pass filter.
Sort keratinocytes into two populations: EpSC and TA cells.
Collect all data using linear amplification in list mode.
Culture the EpSC obtained in Growth Promoting Medium as described earlier (see step 1.5 to 1.6.2).
TA cells fail to adhere to culture surfaces in flasks.
Isolate EpSC from BALB/c adult mouse skin.
Process isolated EpSC for FACSAria based sorting.
Sort processed EpSC using the protocol described in steps 5.4.7 to 5.4.19.
